name: event-reminders
title: Event reminders
description: Set when and how people are reminded of an event, by notification or email.

props.name: title
props.description: The name of the event, shown as the heading.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled list. Leave it out and the card keeps its own.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The reminders the card starts with when it is not controlled.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the full new list whenever a reminder is added, changed or removed.

props.name: max
props.description: Most reminders one event can have.

props.name: labels
props.description: Visible text and screen reader text with English defaults, for channels, units, “before”, and the add, remove, more, less and change buttons.

a11y.text: Every control is a native button: the channel pill, the minus and plus buttons, the unit pill, remove and add. Minus and plus are disabled at their limits.

A section with an h2 title and a list of reminders. The channel and unit pills are named by what they change plus their value, for example "Change channel: Email", set through labels. Minus, plus and remove are named from labels. A status region that stays in the page reads the new value after each change, for example "Email, 30 minutes before". Icons are aria-hidden.
The list uses Motion with reduced motion set to user.
